main_text.l: PROGRAMMA A-CADEMICVM DE ACTV dectura[?] Theologica.
ECCLESIAE ET ACADEMIAE Basiliensis fidis Pastoribus, Doctoribus, & iuuentuti virtutum & doctrinæ studio florenti,
IOH. IACOBVS GRYNAEVS, PRO-motor rite designatus.

l.i: NIHIL dubium est pÿs[?] mentibus, quæ Ecclesiæ, ceu communi parenti, optimè volunt, gratam esse hanc dulcissimam imaginem Arboris Medicæ, Ecclesiam Christi, sua quadam eleganti imagine repræsentantis. Quēadmodū. n. Citrea seu Medica malus, quando nec solùm fœcunditas, nec cœli Solisq; clementia ei deest, adeò est fœcunda, ut & flores & fructus eodem tempore respectandos exhibeat, & omnibus horis fit pomifera, aliis videlicet cadētibus, aliis maturescentibus, aliis deniq; subnascentibus: sic Ecclesia Dei, renata non ex mortali semine, sed ex immortali, per sermonem Dei vivi & manen-

page.notes: Woodcut initial N at the start of the body text, joined to NIHIL. The word pÿs is read as printed (abbreviation for piis) and is doubtful. The title word after DE ACTV is printed as "dectura" in italic; the initial letter is doubtful and may be a long-form l. The mark between PRO and motor in the author line is a dot or hyphen-like printer's sign. The text is set in italic throughout the body. The catchword manen- is printed at the right below the last line.
